description: Suggests the rest of a line or a small block while you type, from a code model that runs on this computer or on a server of your own. Tab accepts.
configuration.title: Tab Completion
configuration.enabled: Suggest the rest of a line or a small block while typing. Tab accepts a suggestion.
configuration.api: Which kind of model server the endpoint is. Only used when an endpoint is set.
configuration.api.ollama: An Ollama server: requests go to /api/generate.
configuration.api.openai: Any server with an OpenAI-style completions API, such as llama.cpp, MLX or vLLM: requests go to /v1/completions.
configuration.endpoint: Address of a model server of your own. Leave empty to let the editor run the model on this computer; it offers to download what it needs.
configuration.model: Name of the model. Leave empty for qwen2.5-coder:1.5b-base, which is small and quick to answer. The larger qwen2.5-coder:7b-base completes somewhat more lines exactly right and takes several times as long; it needs a Mac with 16 GB of memory or more. Both can be chosen in the Tab Completion view. It has to be a code model that can fill in the middle of a file. Of the Qwen Coder models, take a "base" one: the tags without "base" are chat models and complete code less exactly.
configuration.promptTemplate: How the code before and after the cursor is handed to the model. The default fits the Qwen Coder models; other model families use other markers.
configuration.stop: Texts at which the model stops. The default is the list of markers of the Qwen Coder models, which end an answer.
configuration.maxTokens: Upper limit for the length of a suggestion, in model tokens. A suggestion ends by itself at the end of its line or block; this limit is for the cases where it does not. Longer suggestions take longer to arrive.
configuration.debounce: How long to wait after the last keystroke before asking the model, in milliseconds.
configuration.readAhead: Let the model read the code before the cursor ahead of time: as soon as you start to type at a place it has not read yet, and when the cursor rests at such a place shortly after you typed. The first suggestion there then comes after about a second instead of several. Only with the model that the editor runs on this computer.
configuration.disabledLanguages: Languages in which nothing is suggested.
configuration.useOtherFiles: Also show the model the definitions that the current file imports, and similar parts of other files you have open. Suggestions then use the real names from your project. With a model server of your own, these parts and the name of the workspace folder are sent there too. Files that usually hold secrets, such as .env files and keys, are never sent.
configuration.fileSeparator: Marker that the model expects in front of the path of each file when code from several files is sent. The default fits the Qwen Coder models. Leave empty to send only the current file.
configuration.repositoryMarker: Marker that the model expects in front of the name of the project when code from several files is sent. The name of the workspace folder is used. The default fits the Qwen Coder models. Leave empty to send no name.
